scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run make:exe
scripts.postinstall: echo Skipping rebuild - use npm run rebuild:electron if needed
scripts.migration:create: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js migration:create
scripts.migration:run: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js migration:run
scripts.migration:rollback: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js migration:rollback
scripts.migration:reset: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js migration:reset
scripts.seeder:create: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js seeder:create
scripts.seeder:run: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js seeder:run
scripts.seeder:reset: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js seeder:reset
scripts.db:fresh: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js fresh
scripts.db:seed: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js seed
scripts.db:migrate: npm run rebuild:node && node database/cli.js migrate
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run migrate:fresh && npm run seeder:reset && npm run db:seed && npm run rebuild:electron
